author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
We welcome Matt Parker of @standupmaths and @numberphile back to the cave for another build! This time, Adam and Matt attempt to construct a tensegrity structure out of elastic and plastic tubes. The build ends spectacularly, but not in the way either of them expected!

Adam Savage's One Day Builds: Rhombic Dodecahedron with Matt Parker! https://youtu.be/65r_1TzJXaQ
